name: Pray Without Ceasing
overview: Scripture calls believers to a continual and sincere prayer life, emphasizing persistence and faith. Jesus instructs His followers to pray privately and with genuine belief, assuring that all things asked in prayer will be received if prayed with faith. The Spirit aids believers in prayer, interceding on their behalf even when they do not know how to pray as they ought. However, the condition of the heart is crucial, as God will not hear those who harbor iniquity within themselves.
